runs.summary: Firecrawl discovery degraded on operator map rate limits, so this run fell back to direct live verification. Beatrice remained the only strict shortlist survivor; Ten23 floor 7 and 529 East 6th #2B were the strongest live 2BR monitors but both missed the June move window.
runs.notes: Fresh-market rerun after the Firecrawl-first discovery script returned degraded status. Search leads were treated as discovery only; every included row below was manually live-verified on the opened page and then categorized as shortlist, monitor, or excluded.
blindSpots: Firecrawl map calls for direct operator roots hit repeated 429 rate limits, so the discovery file had zero direct-operator candidates.
Avalon West Chelsea and other community pages were discoverable, but the opened pages did not expose trustworthy live unit rows during this pass.
Some StreetEasy and Brodsky search hits still mismatched or resolved to rented / generic pages once opened.
EVE East Village exact unit verification was weaker on this pass because the previously useful unit URL no longer exposed the same floor-plan detail cleanly.

listings.name: Beatrice Apartments 1BR floor 28

commute.route: R/W to Prince Street or walk
commute.notes: About 18-22 minutes by subway or a low-20s walk to 1 Example Plaza.

amenities: Central heat and AC in all rooms
listings.mustHaveEvidence: Direct Equity page showed a 643 sq ft 1BR / 1BA on floor 28 for $5,831 available 5/17/2026, plus in-home washer and dryer, dishwasher, central heat and AC in all rooms, and 10-foot ceilings with floor-to-ceiling windows.
listings.furnitureFit: 643 sq ft with high floor-plan confidence clears the 100 inch couch plus coffee-table requirement.
caveats: At the top of the preferred 1BR budget band.
Chelsea / NoMad edge rather than deeper village location.
listings.notes: Still the cleanest 1BR package after the fresh search and live verification.

listings.name: 777 6th Avenue 1BR floor 11

commute.route: R/W to Prince Street or walk
commute.notes: About 18-22 minutes with a simple Chelsea commute.

amenities: Individually controlled heat and air conditioning
listings.mustHaveEvidence: Direct Equity page showed a 651 sq ft 1BR / 1BA on floor 11 for $6,091 available 5/29/2026, plus dishwasher in kitchen, individually controlled heat and air conditioning, and floor-to-ceiling windows.
listings.furnitureFit: 651 sq ft and strong floor-plan confidence suggest the living-room setup should fit.
caveats: In-home laundry was not explicit on the opened page.
listings.notes: Strong quality Chelsea backup, but budget and laundry proof keep it out of shortlist.

listings.name: 82 Jane Street APT 2C

commute.notes: Roughly a 15-18 minute walk to 1 Example Plaza.

listings.mustHaveEvidence: Direct Brodsky building page showed APT 2C as a 1 Bed 1 Bath for $5,600 available 05/18/2026 and confirmed laundry facilities.
listings.furnitureFit: No floor plan or square footage was exposed, so the sofa setup still needs an in-person check.
caveats: No floor plan or square footage on the opened page.
A/C and heating were not explicit.
Building-level photo set rather than a high-confidence unit package.
listings.notes: Excellent West Village commute and timing, but too many unresolved must-haves for shortlist.

listings.name: Ten23 Apartments 2BR floor 7

commute.route: C/E to Spring Street or walk
commute.notes: About 20-25 minutes with a simple commute pattern.

listings.mustHaveEvidence: Direct Equity page showed a 977 sq ft 2BR / 2BA on floor 7 for $8,550 available 7/10/2026, plus in-home washer and dryer availability, microwave and dishwasher, and floor-to-ceiling windows.
listings.furnitureFit: 977 sq ft with strong photo and floor-plan confidence comfortably clears the living-room fit bar.
caveats: Availability is well after the June 1-7 target window.
A/C and heating were not explicit on the opened page during this pass.
listings.notes: Real and attractive, but timing alone keeps it out of shortlist.

listings.name: 529 East 6th Street #2B

commute.notes: Generally a 25-30 minute East Village commute depending on exact route.

listings.mustHaveEvidence: Opened StreetEasy page described a newly renovated 2 bedroom with 2 marble bathrooms, washer and dryer, and a granite kitchen with stainless steel appliances including a dishwasher.
listings.furnitureFit: No square footage or floor plan was provided, so living-room fit still needs confirmation.
caveats: No floor plan or square footage on the opened page.
A/C and heating were not explicit.
listings.notes: Worth monitoring because the price is strong for a true 2BR / 2BA in the East Village, but timing and layout confidence are not there yet.

listings.name: 28 Greenwich Avenue search mismatch
listings.availabilityDisplay: Brodsky rentals search showed available now, but the opened building page showed no current apartments.

commute.notes: Commute would be excellent if the unit were actually live.

listings.mustHaveEvidence: Could only verify that the Brodsky search surface and the opened building page conflicted on current availability.
listings.furnitureFit: Not assessed because live availability was not consistent.
caveats: Search page and building page disagreed on whether a unit is available.
rejectionReasons: Opened building page said currently no apartments available.
Could not verify a live unit, floor plan, or must-haves on the opened page.
listings.notes: Good example of why the run stayed aggressive about rejecting stale operator search hits.

listings.name: 290 West 12th Street #3A

commute.notes: Very strong commute, but no longer available.

listings.mustHaveEvidence: Opened StreetEasy page clearly labeled the unit rented 5/13/2026 while still showing the prior $8,995 2 bed / 2 bath detail.
listings.furnitureFit: No need to assess further after the live rented status.
rejectionReasons: No longer available in the current run window.
listings.notes: Fresh stale catch from the West Village 2BR search.

listings.name: 190 Avenue of the Americas #1R

commute.notes: Commute would be easy, but the surfaced lead did not match the opened page.

listings.mustHaveEvidence: Opened StreetEasy page resolved to a rented 1 bed / 1 bath page, not the higher-bedroom current rental surfaced by search.
listings.furnitureFit: Not assessed because the opened page was a mismatch.
rejectionReasons: Opened page did not match the surfaced search lead.
Listing was already rented on the live page.
